ranked.headline: Layer-resolved and causal probes of what genomic and single-cell models encode
ranked.summary: Audits and pre-registered evaluations now test whether genomic and transcriptomic foundation model gains reflect encoded biology or contamination.

ranked.headline: Interpretable models map single-cell and multi-omics data to latent regulatory states
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair mechanistic structure with learned latent components to infer regulation, signaling and patient states from single-cell data.

ranked.headline: Genomic language models encode regulatory grammar and replication timing across layers
ranked.summary: DNA sequence foundation models are being probed for interpretable encodings of splicing, replication timing, and replication origins.

ranked.headline: Contrastive graph learning phases haplotypes; HPRC2 expands human pangenome reference
ranked.summary: HPRC2 captures over 99% of common variation in All of Us samples, while reference-free phasing methods now operate directly on de novo human assemblies.

ranked.headline: Chromosome-scale plant genomes link structural variation to traits and sex regions
ranked.summary: Haplotype-resolved and pangenome assemblies now pair chromosome-scale contiguity with gene-level and GWAS analyses across diverse eukaryotic lineages.

ranked.headline: Protein language models extend to PTMs, interactions, enzymes, and peptide properties
ranked.summary: Recent 2026 preprints and publications extend sequence-based language model representations to modified residues, protein complexes, and enzyme function.

ranked.headline: Deep models decode language, vision and emotion from EEG, ECoG and iEEG
ranked.summary: Real-world feasibility and cross-task generalization are the open questions for human neural decoding, and recent work tests both.

ranked.headline: Biologically constrained, uncertainty-aware models for gene regulatory network inference
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple probabilistic, causal, and biology-informed models with large expression and proteomic datasets for network inference.

ranked.headline: Non-canonical binding modes and affinity estimates treated as joint constraints in design
ranked.summary: Benchmarks put templated docking at 30-50% success on alternative binding modes versus 70-90% on Astex, motivating constraint-based approaches.

ranked.headline: Transcriptomic tools infer gene programs, lncRNA links and drug perturbation effects
ranked.summary: Expression-based inference tools now integrate single-cell perturbation atlases, patient lncRNA networks and multi-omics agents at increasing scale.

ranked.headline: Omics analysis methods packaged as desktop, browser, container and R tools
ranked.summary: Established peptide, microarray, RNA-seq and gene-set methods are now delivered as accessible, interactive software for routine use.

ranked.headline: Foundation models and histology predictors infer spatial molecular profiles
ranked.summary: Benchmarks now test whether single-cell and spatial foundation models generalise across tasks, and whether histology predicts spatial gene expression.

ranked.headline: Computational genomics links fragmentation, copy-number, and epigenomic states
ranked.summary: Recent methods jointly analyze long-read variants, methylation, single-cell CNVs, and fragmentation patterns across genomes, transcriptomes, and cfDNA.

ranked.headline: Phylogeny-aware methods link microbial genes to abundance phenotypes in metagenomes
ranked.summary: Large genome collections such as GlobDB and biobank phylogenies now anchor phylogeny-aware gene association and read placement in metagenomic studies.

ranked.headline: Learned and ranked structural features predict contacts, interfaces, and phase separation
ranked.summary: Ranked atom environments, AlphaFold v3 interface features, and protein language model embeddings are now used as inputs to scoring and prediction.

ranked.headline: High-coverage single-cell and regulatory network analyses reveal organizational structure
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers apply high-coverage single-cell, co-expression and connectome analyses to resolve cell- and circuit-level organization.

ranked.headline: Interactive tools make long-read architecture and genome rearrangements inspectable
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications from July 2026 present browser and terminal tools for inspecting sequence architecture and genome structure.

ranked.headline: Structured omics representations paired with reliability and scale-dependence testing
ranked.summary: Omics prediction methods are now assessed for cross-cohort reliability and scale dependence, not only for their representational design.

ranked.headline: Deep learning links single-cell expression, 3D chromatin and spatial multiomics
ranked.summary: Spatial and single-cell multiomics now pair expression, chromatin and neighborhood context, demanding models that integrate across modalities and slices.

ranked.headline: Uncertainty-aware latent models infer structure in neuroimaging and disease data
ranked.summary: Recent work couples latent-structure models with explicit uncertainty treatment for phenotypes, brain connectivity, cortical folding, and disease progression.

ranked.headline: Open pipelines quantify biological dynamics from spatial, lipid, and cardiac data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a 2026 publication report open computational pipelines for spatial omics, lipid transport, and cardiac video analysis.

ranked.headline: Deep learning classifies single-molecule and C. elegans imaging data
ranked.summary: Vision transformers and CNNs now automate classification and tracking across nanopore, smFRET, and C. elegans datasets.

ranked.headline: ODE models resolve slow stress dynamics and constrain parameters under partial data
ranked.summary: Dynamic models now pair uncertainty quantification, steady-state sampling, and causal machine learning to interrogate biological system behavior.

ranked.headline: Viral genome catalogs and host-directed screens expand virus diversity and analysis
ranked.summary: Large-scale virome and genome datasets now make viral diversity, host-directed drug targets, and defective genome artifacts analyzable at scale.

ranked.headline: Hi-C and deep learning models link 3D genome architecture to regulatory function
ranked.summary: Cross-platform Hi-C meta-analysis and foundation models now assign 3D genome readouts to specific architectural factors and regulatory functions.

ranked.headline: Structure predictions guide design of nucleases, base editors and escape variants
ranked.summary: Predicted structures and contact probabilities are now used to prioritize candidate sequences before experimental testing.

ranked.headline: Colocalization and splicing-aware methods nominate causal regulatory variants
ranked.summary: Cross-cohort and single-cell QTL data now pair with sequence-based splicing prediction to nominate causal regulatory variants beyond association.

ranked.headline: Noise sets transient bimodality and fluctuation persistence in regulatory circuits
ranked.summary: Recent preprints formalize transient bimodality, large-deviation statistics, and cyclic noise in gene regulatory models relevant to fate decisions.

ranked.headline: Assembly-coupled FlhG feedback on FlrA gives robust control of flagellar number
ranked.summary: Stochastic models now tie single-cell variability in flagellar number to feedback architecture, with noise trade-offs made explicit.

ranked.headline: Models and single-cell profiling map vascular remodeling in aging, plaque and healing
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and one published model extend vascular dynamics analysis to aging, plaque stability, post-surgical healing and angiogenesis.

ranked.headline: Free-energy simulations quantify biomolecular state populations and binding energetics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications apply MD, REUS, alchemical cycles, and least-action models to energetics of DNA junctions, KRAS, and protein evolution.

ranked.headline: MD and enhanced sampling resolve gating, BH3 binding, and disordered-chain conformations
ranked.summary: Simulation methods now sample conformational states that static structures miss, with force-field and field-driven effects becoming analyzable variables.

ranked.headline: Ensemble learning and multi-environment GWAS refine crop trait prediction and mapping
ranked.summary: Crop studies now pair ensemble prediction, environment-aware modeling, and peak-level reporting to move association results toward trait prediction.

ranked.headline: Comparative genomics extends conserved non-coding element and lncRNA orthology mapping
ranked.summary: Reference-quality genome assemblies now anchor scalable comparative analyses of conserved elements, lncRNA orthology, and parasite genome evolution.

ranked.headline: Flanking sequence, nucleosome positioning and mesoscale context shape TF binding
ranked.summary: Recent work quantifies flanking sequence, nucleosome positioning and mesoscale chromatin context as determinants of TF binding behavior.

ranked.headline: Uncertainty-aware cryo-EM fitting and cryoET CTF estimation advance structural analysis
ranked.summary: Cryo-EM and cryoET preprints add uncertainty weighting and GPU-based CTF estimation, while Siibra links heterogeneous brain data to reference atlases.

ranked.headline: Learned models and enzyme-constrained networks extend genome-scale metabolic prediction
ranked.summary: Three recent studies couple learned models and structural tools to genome-scale metabolic reconstruction and simulation.

ranked.headline: Stability of computational shortlists and partitions under altered analytic choices
ranked.summary: Recent preprints treat reproducibility testing as an integral analysis step across metabolomics, gene co-expression, and single-cell clustering.

ranked.headline: Inheritance and representational structure constrain accessible evolutionary innovations
ranked.summary: Simulation and model studies from July 2026 link ploidy, path dependence, and gene transfer structure to which evolutionary outcomes are reachable.

ranked.headline: Versioned lineage, validation, and benchmarking embedded in omics analysis tools
ranked.summary: Three preprints embed validation, lineage tracking, and benchmark registries into omics tools for clinical and pathogen work.
